title: They were fined $811m for conning migrants - the scams didn't stop
summary:
Her friends had paid her bail, and she wanted to look presentable when she was finally released.
Her friends had wired $2,600 (£1,970) to a bond company, Libre Immigration Services (LIS), that had been recommended by her lawyer.
LIS said it would begin "the process of paying her immigration bond".
What she didn't know was that LIS was owned by a convicted fraudster, who had acquired the assets of another bail company co-founded by two men who also had fraud convictions.
Their firm, Libre By Nexus, which was at one point the largest immigration bail company in America, had appeared to shut down after federal regulators caught up with them.

title: Anti-migrant activist Daniel Thomas jailed for slashing migrant dinghy
summary:
Anti-migrant activist Daniel Thomas has been jailed for 15 months for slashing a dinghy with a knife in the English Channel.
The 37-year-old, known to his supporters as Danny Tommo, live-streamed himself cutting the boat while a French rescue worker was on board in September.
Thomas founded the anti-migrant group Patriot Platform, which was behind protests in Portsmouth and Dover involving masked men in September.
He said "let's get rid of that boat" before slashing it about eight times, the court heard.
After slashing the boat, he shouted at the rescue worker: "Get off the boat, you've got time to get off the boat," the court heard.

title: UK far-right activist ‘Danny Tommo’ jailed for slashing migrant boat
summary:
Daniel Thomas livestreamed himself slashing a dinghy used to bring migrants from France to the UK.
A British far-right anti-immigration activist has been jailed for 15 months for criminal damage for slashing a small boat which had brought migrants from France to the United Kingdom.
Thomas livestreamed himself on September 22 as he followed a small boat ⁠⁠carrying migrants across the Channel, who were transferred ⁠⁠onto another vessel and taken ashore.
The 37-year-old later approached the dinghy and slashed it with a knife, soon after a French rescue worker had stepped on board.
AdvertisementJudge Newton-Price accepted that “there was no immediate danger to the rescue worker”, but said Thomas’s actions were a deliberate ‌‌attempt ‌‌to disrupt rescue efforts.

title: Mamdani shuts Bronx migrant shelter at center of ICE fight over residents’ data
summary:
The Mamdani administration closed the last remaining migrant shelter, a Mott Haven facility that was the target of an ICE subpoena seeking the names and birthdays of men residing there.
“There will be no more residents living inside of Bruckner, and the site is officially closed,” Mamdani said in a statement.
The order directed city agencies to phase out its remaining emergency migrant shelter and bring other facilities into compliance with city rules, such as capping the number of residents at 200.
A federal judge earlier this month ordered the Mamdani administration to hand over the personal information of certain residents staying in the shelter.
Under the Trump administration, ICE had tried at least four times to obtain information about shelter residents.

title: Four bodies recovered after Senegal boat capsizes amid migration surge
summary:
Four bodies have been recovered after a migrant boat capsized off Senegal’s coast, as authorities continue searching for survivors amid fears that the death toll could rise significantly.
Canary IslandsThe incident comes amid an intensifying wave of attempted Atlantic crossings from West Africa to Spain’s Canary Islands, with migrant boats being intercepted or rescued almost daily.
New figures from Spain’s Interior Ministry show that 24,364 migrants reached the Canary Islands between January 1 and November 15, compared with 14,690 during the same period last year, an increase of nearly two-thirds.
Just days before the boat capsized, authorities announced the dismantling of a suspected migrant-smuggling network in Yenne itself, arresting 14 people and seizing two boats, three engines and 12.5 million CFA francs ($22,000), according to APS.
Nearly 600 deadThe United Nations refugee agency said nearly 600 people had died trying to reach the Canary Islands from West Africa so far this year, highlighting the dangers of the increasingly busy migration route.

title: Suffolk village votes to 'leave UK' over RAF Barnham migrant plan
summary:
Villagers vowed "this is only the beginning" after voting overwhelmingly to "leave the UK" in protest at plans to house migrants at a former airbase.
Residents in Barnham, Suffolk, held a symbolic poll on Saturday to decide whether or not to declare independence.
Two-hundred-and-fifty-seven people - 94% of those who took part – voted in favour of leaving, 16 voted against and one vote was spoiled.
Barnham is the second village to hold a symbolic poll over migrant housing plans, after residents of Piddington in Oxfordshire voted to leave the UK in September.
John Bauer, chair of the parish council, has said the Suffolk village will now declare itself the Bailiwick of Barnham.

title: Bush Center Urges Democrats to Welcome the Next Flood of Migrants
summary:
Democrats should legalize many illegal migrants and also fund a border welcome for the next flood of illegal migrants, says the immigration director at the George W. Bush Presidential Center in Texas.
Under President Joe Biden, Democrats provided more than $20 billion to welcome, feed, transport, and house roughly 8 million economic migrants.
From 2001 to 2009, President George W. Bush welcomed many millions of wage-cutting illegal migrants into his two terms.
Bush’s support for immigration was enabled by his father, George H. W. Bush, who worked with Democrats — including then Rep. Chuck Schumer (D-NY) — in 1990 to double legalized immigration inflows.
